findings.root_cause: The WebView capture dispatcher had no TYPE_NEU branch, so NEU fell through to the generic Wisedu endpoint sequence.
findings.fix: Added a dedicated TYPE_NEU branch and NEU_FETCH_JS for getMyScheduleDetail.do with session credentials and the existing bridge envelope.

findings.root_cause: NEU ICS uses a custom PRODID and event time blocks that require NEU-specific node inference; generic fallback can assign the wrong section.
findings.fix: NEU-specific ICS node inference remains selected by PRODID, while explicit section descriptions remain authoritative; round-trip regression added.

findings.root_cause: Group-level replacement could delete or rewrite same-name rows in different rooms together.
findings.fix: RowKey includes schedule slot, room, and teacher; save uses row-level diff/patch.
findings.verification: RowKeyDifferTest passed, including multi-location delete/update isolation.

findings.root_cause: Irregular node and custom-duration state was not consistently owned by each meeting block.
findings.fix: Per-block irregular state, explicit node/time anchors, edge-node persistence, and unused-edge cleanup are covered in the current implementation.

online_limit: Live NEU service validation was not run; it requires an authenticated session and reachable service.
